QuestInfo.name: Black Wings Hat 1
QuestInfo.0: You traveled to the Road to the Mine 1 in search of a #bBlack Wings Hat#k and... Oh no! Someone's coming!
QuestInfo.1: #p2159421# wants to make you an offer.
QuestInfo.2: #p2159421# looks like a member of the Black Wings. Still, couldn't hurt to listen.

0.0: What are you doing here, bumpkin? There are to be no civilian trespassers near the mines while the Black Wings work.  Go back to the city before I report you to my superiors. Unless...
0.1: You seem the type to be loose with a coin purse. I could be persuaded to be so loose with my tongue, for a price. Come speak to me in secret if you're interested in making a deal...

no.0: I won't force you to take a good deal. See how far you get without my services.

1.0: Very well, let us complete this transaction.
